title: Data verification & validation
summary: Verifying weather data before sending it to a remote server.
overview: An ESP32 and FPGA receive weather data from a peripheral device. The system computes a CRC checksum, packetizes the data, and sends it to a remote server for display.
components: ESP32 and FPGA for the data verification system.
CRC checksum computation and data packetization.
Remote server for displaying the transmitted data.
